in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Brave, Victorious, God-like

It is a powerful name that evokes images of strength and triumph. In Hindu mythology, Surjeet is the name of the sun god, Surya, who represents power, light, and life-giving energy. This name is perfect for a baby boy who is destined for greatness and success.
